evidence_boundaries: No missing artifact was encountered among the retained paths used for this adjudication. Full integer comparison-tail coverage is absent by design: only4calibration-prefix windows per mode were requested.

F32 targets.bin contains selected target probabilities and NLLs, not every vocabulary probability. Full-vector finite/normalization evidence is the completed Rust evaluator checks and reported maximum sum error; the read-only parser independently checked every recorded target.

Integer JSONL contains measured maximum drift and probability hashes, not complete state/probability vectors. Recorded row maxima were independently recomputed; underlying per-coordinate maxima are the existing Rust measurement.
Zero-update calibration preserves optimizer bytes/clocks and nearest hard codes but changes reported outlying shadow coordinates. It is not a blanket zero-model-change claim.
Exact export reload is the recorded full-context probability comparison plus48-token-cap loaded smoke; it is not a new replay or corpus-wide saturation proof.
First-noun and exact complete-source memberships are different measurements. All gains and losses, including historical negatives and admission overrides, remain in the row-level comparison.
F32 noncollapse pass is only the five fixed continuations and period1..4 final-three-block criterion; useful language is adjudicated separately. Standalone quaternion period1 failure is retained.
